WITH college_counts AS (
  SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) as player_count
  FROM player_college
  GROUP BY college_id
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(player_count) as avg_player_count,
    SUM(player_count) as total_players
  FROM college_counts
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT cc.player_count, s.avg_player_count, s.total_players
  FROM college_counts cc
  CROSS JOIN stats s
  WHERE cc.player_count > s.avg_player_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(player_count) as avg_player_count,
  AVG(player_count::NUMERIC / total_players::NUMERIC) as avg_fraction_of_total,
  AVG(player_count - avg_player_count) as avg_excess_over_average
FROM above_average

assumptions.assumption: NULL college_id values are treated as a single group (grouped together in GROUP BY), not excluded from analysis
Division is performed with full numeric precision (casting to NUMERIC avoids integer division)
